failureModeLibrary.description: {@link FailureModeLibrary} representing the library associated with the failure mode.

expectedSensorName.description: Name of the sensor expected to be associated with this failure mode.

diagnostic.description: {@link FailureModeDiagnostic} representing the diagnostic details for the failure mode.

failureMode.description: {@link FailureMode} representing the specific failure mode being referenced.

priority.description: {@link FailureModePriority} representing the priority assigned to this failure mode.

exceptions.description: A string detailing any exceptions associated with this spec.

faultCategory.description: A string representing the fault category, which is an enumeration of {@link FailureModeFaultCategory}.

unit.description: {@link Unit} representing the unit of measure for this failure mode line item.
